title: Keyser
wikitext:
English player, most known for his time with [[Firing Squad]], in earlier years with [[Four Kings]]. Is a professional football player, won the League of Wales three times as a defender for TNS and the Welsh Cup once. Played both legs of the Champions League First Qualifying Round against Liverpool and in Europe on six other occasions.
